title: bancalus orientalis
intro: Bancalus orientalis, commonly known as Wild Asafoetida, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. It is known for its distinct pungent smell and is traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Bancalus orientalis include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and digestive issues.
